name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) captures 'Reach the exit' and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) captures 'you must have flipped the switch first'; together they force both events and their order, matching the task exactly.

texts: The agent must reach the exit at some point.
The switch must have been toggled before the agent reaches the exit.
machine:
